title: 'This place is crazy': Ex-Apple engineer's texts highlight OpenAI's AI-centric workplace
excerpt: Apple filed a trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI and OpenAI publicly released a series of text messages as part of its defense.
content_html:
By Natalie Musumeci

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

One notable detail to emerge from the brewing legal battle between Apple and OpenAI isn't about trade secrets at all — it's about workplace culture and internal AI use.

In a series of iMessages released Tuesday as part of OpenAI's public response to Apple's trade secrets lawsuit against it, a former Apple engineer-turned-OpenAI staffer at the center of the case suggested that working at OpenAI was markedly different from working at Apple.

"This place is crazy… hahahah we use Ai all over the place," Chang Liu said in a text message to one of his former Apple colleagues shortly after he left the iPhone maker earlier this year to join ChatGPT creator OpenAI.

Liu, who spent eight years at Apple as a senior system electrical engineer and is named among the defendants in Apple's lawsuit, said in another text made public by OpenAI: "This startup style company is a funny and will be very hard in a couple months😁😁."

The messages offer a rare glimpse into one engineer's inside perspective on Apple, a 50-year-old company, and OpenAI, a decade-old startup, as the tech companies race to build the next generation of AI.

The texts were among a collection of messages and emails that OpenAI published in a blog post titled "Apple is getting this wrong," as it defended itself against the company's lawsuit.

Apple's federal lawsuit accuses OpenAI, along with Liu and Tang Tan — a former Apple employee and current OpenAI hardware chief — of stealing Apple's confidential information.

The lawsuit accuses the defendants of "exploiting Apple's confidential information to advance OpenAI's efforts to enter the consumer hardware market."

In the Tuesday blog post, OpenAI slammed Apple's July lawsuit as "careless, aggressive and oddly personal" and said, "We do not have, nor want, any of their trade secrets."

"Apple accuses Chang Liu of accessing Apple confidential information after leaving the company, but only now admits that Apple employees reached out to him and asked for his help to locate this information," OpenAI wrote.

Beyond the legal fight, Liu's text messages underscore a seemingly broader contrast between Apple and OpenAI's internal approaches to artificial intelligence.

While Apple executives have publicly described AI as increasingly integrated across the company, they have offered relatively few details about how employees use large language models in their day-to-day work.

On an earnings call last year, Apple CEO Tim Cook said the company sees AI "as one of the most profound technologies of our lifetime," adding, "We are embedding it across our devices and platforms and across the company."

OpenAI execs, on the other hand, have openly detailed how AI is integrated across the business. Former OpenAI chief product officer, Kevin Weil, said on "Lenny's Podcast" last year that company employees use AI "a lot."

"I mean, every one of us is in ChatGPT all the time summarizing docs, using it to help write docs with GPTs that write product specs and things like that — all the stuff that you would imagine," Weil said.

Representatives for OpenAI and Apple did not immediately respond to requests for comment by Business Insider on Tuesday.

作者：Natalie Musumeci 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

苹果和 OpenAI 之间正在酝酿的法律战中出现的一个值得注意的细节根本不是商业秘密，而是工作场所文化和内部人工智能的使用。

在周二发布的一系列 iMessages 中，作为 OpenAI 对苹果对其商业机密诉讼的公开回应的一部分，案件中心的一位前苹果工程师、后来成为 OpenAI 的员工表示，在 OpenAI 工作与在苹果工作明显不同。

“这个地方太疯狂了…… 哈哈哈，我们到处都在使用人工智能。”今年早些时候，刘畅离开这家 iPhone 制造商，加入 ChatGPT 创建者 OpenAI 后不久，他在给一位前苹果同事的短信中说道。

刘在苹果担任了八年的高级系统电气工程师，并被列为苹果诉讼的被告之一，他在 OpenAI 公开的另一篇文章中表示：“这家初创型公司很有趣，几个月后就会变得非常艰难😁😁。”

随着科技公司竞相构建下一代人工智能，这些消息让我们难得一睹一位工程师对苹果（一家拥有 50 年历史的公司）和 OpenAI（一家拥有十年历史的初创公司）的内部看法。

这些文本是 OpenAI 在一篇题为“苹果公司搞错了”的博客文章中发布的一系列消息和电子邮件中的一部分，因为它针对该公司的诉讼进行了辩护。

苹果的联邦诉讼指控 OpenAI 以及前苹果员工、现任 OpenAI 硬件负责人刘和唐坦窃取苹果的机密信息。

该诉讼指控被告“利用苹果的机密信息来推进 OpenAI 进军消费硬件市场的努力”。

在周二的博客文章中，OpenAI 抨击苹果 7 月份的诉讼是“粗心、咄咄逼人且奇怪的个人行为”，并表示，“我们没有、也不想要他们的任何商业秘密。”

OpenAI 写道：“苹果指控刘畅在离开公司后访问了苹果的机密信息，但直到现在才承认苹果员工曾联系过他并请求他帮助查找这些信息。”

除了法律斗争之外，刘的短信还强调了苹果和 OpenAI 内部人工智能方法之间看似更广泛的对比。

尽管苹果高管公开表示人工智能在整个公司范围内的集成度越来越高，但他们并没有提供有关员工如何在日常工作中使用大型语言模型的详细信息。

在去年的财报电话会议上，苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克表示，该公司将人工智能视为“我们一生中最深刻的技术之一”，并补充道，“我们正在将其嵌入到我们的设备和平台以及整个公司中。”

另一方面，OpenAI 高管公开详细介绍了人工智能如何在整个业务中集成。 OpenAI 前首席产品官 Kevin Weil 去年在“Lenny's Podcast”上表示，公司员工“大量”使用人工智能。

“我的意思是，我们每个人都一直在 ChatGPT 中总结文档，用它来帮助用 GPT 编写文档，编写产品规格和类似的东西 - 所有你能想象到的东西，”Weil 说。

OpenAI 和苹果的代表周二没有立即回应 Business Insider 的置评请求。

Natalie 是《商业内幕》商业新闻团队的高级记者。她之前曾在 BI 法律事务团队工作，负责报道州和联邦法院以外的重大案件以及破产案件。 她的报道经常关注法律、商业、政治和技术交叉领域的故事。 娜塔莉报道过唐纳德·特朗普的刑事和民事案件、针对特朗普第二届政府的诉讼浪潮、肖恩·“老爹”库姆斯的起诉和刑事审判、联合医疗保健首席执行官布莱恩·汤普森被枪杀，以及埃隆·马斯克及其公司面临的法律斗争。 娜塔莉于 2021 年 6 月加入《商业内幕》，担任突发新闻记者，专注于当天热门新闻最有趣的角度。 娜塔莉主要推动了 BI 围绕亚历克·鲍德温 (Alec Baldwin) 致命枪击事件以及加比·佩蒂托 (Gabby Petito) 失踪和谋杀案的报道。在加入 BI 之前，娜塔莉曾在《纽约邮报》、《纽约每日新闻》和《布鲁克林报》工作。 她拥有犯罪和法庭方面的广泛背景。 在她超过 12 年的新闻职业生涯中，她曾在纽约警察局总部报道过警察被殴打的事件。 娜塔莉是布鲁克林人，2012 年毕业于布鲁克林学院，获得新闻学学位。 热门文章
